exams.name: Journeyman Electrician Examination
exams.notes: Required for journeyman electrician license; apprentice must complete required related instruction and work hours before taking exam
exams.quote: An apprentice electrician, as defined in section 54-1003A, Idaho Code, may take the journeyman's examination if he has completed the required related instruction for electrical apprentices

exams.name: Residential Electrician Examination
exams.notes: Required for residential electrician license; applicant must pass exam, complete two-year instruction course, and submit proof of 4,000 hours of electrical experience
exams.quote: A person qualifies for a residential electrician license if he passes the residential electrician examination approved by the board

exams.name: Master Electrician Examination
exams.notes: Applicant must have worked as licensed journeyman for at least 4 years and required hours as prescribed by board rule
exams.quote: Any person who has worked as a licensed journeyman for a period of not less than four (4) years and who has worked the number of hours as prescribed by rule of the board as a licensed journeyman electrician shall be considered as qualified to apply for a master electrician's license
